info.name: Meenakshi - Phase 7 Collections operations
info.description: Use only after 20260808000000_phase_7_collections_operations.sql. It verifies safe review-only defaults, role boundaries, reconciliation-gated posting, and sanitized operational diagnostics. No request contains Tally XML, credentials, customer phone data, or MSG91 secrets.

exec: pm.test('safe default is review-only or an explicitly enabled control', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().launchControl.mode).to.be.oneOf(['review_only', 'posting_enabled']));
pm.test('health never exposes raw Tally XML', () => pm.expect(text).to.not.include('<ENVELOPE'));
pm.test('health does not expose MSG91 keys', () => pm.expect(text.toLowerCase()).to.not.include('msg91_authkey'));

item.name: 3. Finance Approver cannot change launch control

exec: pm.test('Finance Approver is forbidden from changing launch state', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));

item.description: Set finance_access_token to a valid Finance Approver token. Skip this request if the test account has only Administrator access.

item.name: 4. Posting enablement without reconciliation is rejected

exec: pm.test('incomplete posting gate is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400));

item.name: 5. Enable posting with recorded reconciliation

exec: pm.test('posting is enabled with recorded reconciliation', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('audit-ready reconciliation metadata is returned', () => { const control = pm.response.json().launchControl; pm.expect(control.mode).to.eql('posting_enabled'); pm.expect(control.reconciliation.reference).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('reconciliation_reference')); });

item.description: Administrator only. Use a non-production reconciliation reference during local tests.

exec: pm.test('detail excludes raw XML and payloads', () => { pm.expect(text).to.not.include('<ENVELOPE'); pm.expect(text).to.not.include('recipient_phone_e164'); });

item.name: 7. Restore review-only mode

exec: pm.test('safe review-only mode is restored', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.description: Run this final request after the local authorization test so the company returns to its safe default.
